notes.title: Small bugfixes, adjustments.
notes.notes:
- Thanks to player suggestion adjusted the property and rent prices accordingly. 
- Adjusted vehicle prices slightly. 
- Fixed the health stats increasing quite rapidly, so reduced the hunger, and thirst. Sleep still stay once per day.

If you have any more further suggestions regarding features you would like to see, please feel free to contact us.

notes.title: Casino arrives at City
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Followers,[/b] [/p][p]Firstly I would like to congrats everyone with the Early Access, where you have the opportunity to test out Side Hustle City.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656324/eaefb4b8040bc63dbf3d7d93e8df2dbae8c3b5da.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Lo and behold — Casino is here![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]is it already time for the first Major Feature? - sure thing. We introduce you all to Blackjack system, Slots Machine system, Chips system, and did I mention that it's all after 22:00?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656324/2a96f9cc78341c3eaa01c05d0542186f4312b3cb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Blackjack (Player vs. Dealer)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Two-card deal, dealer hole-card reveal, [b]Hit / Stand / Double[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic pacing (card-by-card animations, reveal beats, result hold).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Table limits:[/b] 5–100 chips . [b]Blackjack pays 3:2[/b] (rounded down to whole chips).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Slot Machines[/b][/p][list][*][p]Walk up, press [b]E[/b] to play, simple bet flow consistent with the table.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimum spin: 5 chips[/b] (matches table minimum).[/p][/*][*][p]Uses the same Chips wallet and interaction prompts as the rest of the casino.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibility to enjoy all 3 slot machines at same time, if you can afford it. ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][*][p]Nice green overlay with text, and visuals so you never miss winnings.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chips Economy[/b][/p][list][*][p]One wallet across the casino—earn, spend, win, and push are reflected everywhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibility to purchase, sell chips by local worker - keep good count, can he fool you?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656324/99e385ed8bd1e2e1fc832848b0f53b73d5bb27d8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Call to action[/b][/h3][p]Please share with us how the Casino system pacing feels, what rules/games you'd like to implement next. We always listen to your feedback - and try to provide.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
